title: Anthropic’s IPO Fails to Revive AI Trade
title_zh: Anthropic 的 IPO 未能重振 AI 交易
subtitle: Anthropic 的 IPO 未能重振 AI 交易
author: Emma Tucker

sentences.en: Wall Street was looking to Anthropic’s blockbuster IPO for an answer to a big question: Are investors still willing to bet on the AI boom?
sentences.zh: 華爾街把 Anthropic 這場轟動的 IPO 當成一個大問題的答案：投資人是否仍願意押注 AI 熱潮？

sentences.en: The answer wasn’t quite so simple.
Its shares opened more than 30% above the offering price Thursday but closed up 17%, while the broader market slumped.
sentences.zh: 其股票週四開盤較發行價高出 30% 以上，但收盤僅上漲 17%，同一時間大盤卻大幅下跌。

sentences.en: Our reporters explain why Anthropic’s debut was a success for the company and its backers, yet failed to revive the AI trade.
sentences.zh: 本報記者解釋，為何 Anthropic 的掛牌對公司和金主來說是成功的，卻未能重振 AI 交易。

sentences.en: But there may be reason to distinguish Anthropic’s prospects from those of the AI industry as a whole.
sentences.zh: 不過，或許有理由把 Anthropic 的前景，和整個 AI 產業區分開來。

sentences.en: Asa Fitch argues that a potentially more lucrative phase of the artificial-intelligence boom is taking shape, one in which companies like Anthropic could draw more profits from applying the technology rather than building its infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 艾薩・費奇認為，AI 熱潮一個可能更有利可圖的階段正在成形：像 Anthropic 這樣的公司，將更能從「應用」這項技術、而非「建造」基礎設施中獲取利潤。

sentences.en: President Trump’s whirlwind trip to Asia offered a glimpse into how he hopes to cement his legacy through foreign-policy breakthroughs.
sentences.zh: 川普總統旋風式的亞洲行，讓人得以一窺他希望如何透過外交突破來鞏固自己的政績。

sentences.en: China’s tech champions were already limping as they tried to keep pace with U.S. competitors at the cutting edge of AI.
sentences.zh: 中國的科技龍頭在試圖跟上美國競爭對手、搶占 AI 最前沿時，本來就已經步履蹣跚。

sentences.en: New U.S. rules issued in the aftermath of the scandal at Nvidia are set to slow them down even more.
sentences.zh: 輝達醜聞之後，美國公布的新規定勢必會讓他們更加遲緩。

sentences.en: In closed-door peace talks, Trump’s envoy Jared Kushner has discussed a surprising bargain: Ukraine would cede territory to Russia in exchange for NATO membership.
sentences.zh: 在閉門和談中，川普特使庫許納討論了一個出人意料的方案：烏克蘭向俄羅斯割讓領土，以換取加入北約。

sentences.en: Oil prices have retreated from their recent highs, but they’re still nowhere near prewar levels.
sentences.zh: 油價已從近期高點回落，但仍遠遠高於戰前水準。

sentences.en: Persistent attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, soaring shipping costs and depleted global inventories are keeping prices elevated, even as oil production and exports recover.
sentences.zh: 荷莫茲海峽油輪持續遇襲、運費飆升，加上全球庫存枯竭，即使石油生產和出口正在復甦，價格仍居高不下。

sentences.en: The crustless PB&J sandwiches are so coveted that sailors sometimes trade them for other valuable items.
sentences.zh: 這種去邊的花生果醬三明治如此搶手，以致水兵有時會拿來交換其他貴重物品。

vocab.usage: a blockbuster IPO 轟動的上市；blockbuster movie 賣座電影；也可當形容詞
vocab.example: The studio released a blockbuster last summer.
vocab.example_zh: 那家片廠去年夏天推出了一部賣座大片。

vocab.usage: the AI boom AI 熱潮；an economic boom 經濟榮景；動詞 boom＝急速成長
vocab.example: Tourism is enjoying a boom this year.
vocab.example_zh: 今年觀光業正迎來一波熱潮。

vocab.usage: above / below the offering price 高於／低於發行價；IPO offering price 上市發行價
vocab.example: The stock closed far above its offering price.
vocab.example_zh: 這檔股票收盤遠高於發行價。

vocab.usage: the market slumped 大盤重挫；名詞 slump 也可指「衰退、暴跌」
vocab.example: Home prices slumped after the rate hike.
vocab.example_zh: 升息之後，房價大幅下跌。

vocab.usage: financial backers 金主；a project backer 專案資助者
vocab.example: The startup thanked its early backers.
vocab.example_zh: 這家新創感謝早期的金主。

vocab.usage: revive the AI trade 重振 AI 交易；revive the economy 振興經濟
vocab.example: Lower rates could revive demand for houses.
vocab.example_zh: 利率下降可能重振買房需求。

vocab.usage: distinguish A from B 把 A 和 B 區分開來；distinguish between A and B
vocab.example: It is hard to distinguish the two products.
vocab.example_zh: 這兩項產品很難區分開來。

vocab.usage: 常用複數；job / growth prospects 就業／成長前景
vocab.example: The company’s prospects improved after the deal.
vocab.example_zh: 這筆交易之後，公司的前景變好了。

vocab.usage: a lucrative contract / market 獲利豐厚的合約／市場
vocab.example: She left for a more lucrative job in finance.
vocab.example_zh: 她轉去金融業做一份更賺錢的工作。

vocab.usage: build infrastructure 建設基礎設施；digital / transport infrastructure
vocab.example: The city needs better public-transport infrastructure.
vocab.example_zh: 這座城市需要更好的公共交通基礎設施。

vocab.usage: a whirlwind trip / tour 旋風式訪問；名詞 whirlwind 是「旋風」
vocab.example: They went on a whirlwind tour of three cities in two days.
vocab.example_zh: 他們兩天內旋風式走訪了三座城市。

vocab.usage: cement one’s legacy / position 鞏固政績／地位；名詞 cement 是「水泥」
vocab.example: The win helped cement her position as team leader.
vocab.example_zh: 這場勝利鞏固了她作為隊長的地位。

vocab.usage: cement / leave a legacy 留下政績或影響；a family legacy 家族遺產
vocab.example: The mayor wants to leave a legacy of cleaner air.
vocab.example_zh: 這位市長想留下空氣變乾淨的政績。

vocab.usage: be limping 走得很艱難；limp along 勉強撐著走
vocab.example: The injured runner limped across the finish line.
vocab.example_zh: 受傷的跑者一瘸一拐地通過終點。

vocab.usage: keep pace with competitors / change 跟上競爭對手／變化
vocab.example: Small shops struggle to keep pace with online giants.
vocab.example_zh: 小店很難跟上網路巨頭的腳步。

vocab.usage: in the aftermath of… 在…之後的餘波中
vocab.example: Many families needed help in the aftermath of the storm.
vocab.example_zh: 暴風雨過後，許多家庭需要援助。

vocab.usage: cede territory to… 把領土割讓給…；cede control 交出控制權
vocab.example: The company refused to cede control to the new investors.
vocab.example_zh: 公司拒絕把控制權交給新投資人。

vocab.usage: prices retreat from highs 價格從高點回落；名詞 retreat 是「撤退、休閒活動」
vocab.example: Stock prices retreated after a strong morning rally.
vocab.example_zh: 早盤大漲之後，股價回落了。

vocab.usage: depleted inventories / savings 耗盡的庫存／存款；動詞 deplete
vocab.example: The hikers returned with depleted water supplies.
vocab.example_zh: 登山者回來時，水已經快用完了。

vocab.usage: a coveted prize / job 人人想要的獎項／工作；動詞 covet 覬覦
vocab.example: She won the coveted award on her first try.
vocab.example_zh: 她第一次參賽就拿到人人想要的獎。
